app.name: Bookable Service
app.summary: Book a service over an interval, pay in REV, and resolve disputes with a reputation-weighted panel.

uniqueValue: Reputation-weighted dispute panel selection over a booked service; payments, capacity and cover are reused.

components.whyExtend: A booked service can attach an existing r-sure policy; the adapter only reads and attaches it.

components.whyUnique: Reputation-weighted panel selection is a coordination protocol; no registered primitive selects or weights a dispute panel.
invariants: a panelist votes once per dispute
the panel cannot include the provider

conservation.assertion: the deposit and the settlement sum to the quoted rent; no path mints or burns

concurrency.risk: two guests acquire the same slot
concurrency.mechanism: r-share's listing allocator takes and commits the slot set once; one winner
the dispute cell records each panelist once before replying

remedies.action: guest opens a dispute; the panel resolves; the booking remedy refunds

acceptance.given: a published listing and a funded guest
acceptance.when: the guest books and the provider confirms
acceptance.then: the slot is held once and the settlement conserves the rent
